name: One Click Buy Now Button
author: MD.Mahfuzul Islam Tuhin

sections.description:
One Click Buy Now Button lets you add a quick checkout button below WooCommerce’s Add to Cart button.
It redirects customers straight to checkout, skipping the cart page.

Features:

  • Enable/Disable option from admin
  • Customize button text, color, and hover color
  • Works with both simple and variable products
  • Secure AJAX-based add-to-cart with nonce verification
  • Lightweight and easy to use
  • Compatible with latest WooCommerce & WordPress
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/one-click-buy-now-button/ directory, or install via WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > One Click Buy to configure options.
sections.faq:
Does it work with variable products?

Yes, the plugin supports both simple and variable products.

Can I disable the Buy Now button?

Yes, you can enable/disable it from the settings page.

Will it replace the Add to Cart button?

No, it adds a new “Buy Now” button under Add to Cart.

Is it secure?

Yes, it uses WordPress nonce verification to prevent unauthorized requests.
